sections.Profile:
Full, released by Interflip S. A. of Madrid in 1977, is an electro-mechanical game for one to four alternating players, sold under the export brand Recreativos Franco used outside Spain. Its playfield carries ten knock-down targets arranged as a rack of bowling pins, five green and five red, which fall flat when hit; dropping every pin of one color lights the matching kick-out hole for a special.

- Manufacturer: Interflip S. A.
- Years made: 1977
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 4
- Tags: Bowling, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s
